turns.answer:
The Tesla Model Y rear-seat screen is a touchscreen located on the back of the center console, facing rear passengers.

On the refreshed Model Y (2025–2026), the factory rear screen is approximately 8 inches and supports:

Entertainment: Watch videos and play supported games.

Climate control: Adjust rear temperature settings and airflow.

Seat controls: Control supported rear-seat heating functions.

Audio: Connect Bluetooth headphones for compatible entertainment.

Front-seat adjustment: Move the front passenger seat using supported controls.

Older Model Y vehicles generally don't come with a factory rear touchscreen, but aftermarket screens are available.

Important: Not every 2026 Model Y includes the rear screen. Tesla currently lists it on Premium and Performance versions, but not the base Model Y.
